title: Kingy Local AI Scoreboard
cite: Kingy AI, Kingy Local AI Scoreboard, https://kingy.ai/local-ai-scoreboard/

scores.csv.model: model name as shown on the page
scores.csv.model_id: stable Kingy id for the model file
scores.csv.machine_id: stable Kingy id for the machine
scores.csv.rented: yes when the card was rented by the hour (RunPod secure cloud)
scores.csv.file_size_gb: file size in GB (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes)
scores.csv.file_sha256_first12: first 12 characters of the file SHA-256
scores.csv.tested: date or date range of the runs (UTC)
scores.csv.score_7_jobs: THE SCORE: average of the seven counted job scores, 0 to 100
scores.csv.score_all_9_jobs: average including the two jobs shown but not counted
scores.csv.lucy_group: tie group on the Lucy AI Studio board; empty on other machines
scores.csv.job_<id>: job score: share of hidden checks passed, averaged over three runs (job ids are in jobs.csv)
scores.csv.writing_time_hours: total model writing time for all 27 runs
scores.csv.tokens_per_second: all tokens written divided by total writing time, from llama.cpp timing
scores.csv.replies_cut_off: replies that hit the length limit
scores.csv.chip_energy_kwh: chip sensor energy for the whole run, Lucy AI Studio only; not power at the wall
scores.csv.speed_note: caveat for the speed figures, when there is one

runs.csv.counted_in_score: yes for the seven counted jobs
runs.csv.checks_passed: hidden checks passed in that run
runs.csv.note: what happened, for the six runs with a checker or server problem

jobs.csv.job_id / job / group: job id, name and kind (Build, Think, Create)
jobs.csv.counted_in_score: yes for the seven counted jobs
jobs.csv.tells_all_8_models_apart / tells_top_6_a: whether the best-to-worst gap is at least 10 points and at least twice the normal swing between a model's own runs
jobs.csv.best_to_worst_gap / normal_swing_between: the two figures behind that test, across the eight models on the Lucy AI Studio
